name: DaxLib.SVG.Def.GradientStop
code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Def.GradientStop' =
		(
			offset: STRING,
			color: STRING,
			opacity: STRING
		) =>

			"<stop offset='" & offset & 
			"' stop-color='" & color & "'" &
			IF( NOT ISBLANK( opacity ), " stop-opacity='" & opacity & "'" ) &
			"/>"
